scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: Farm trip! Mateo, that's not a small horse… that's a donkey, and he likes your sandwich!
scene.intro: Farm trip! Mateo runs to the field: look, a small horse! That is not a horse, says Sofía, that is a donkey. The cow can walk very slowly, the duck can swim, the hen can't fly very far and the goat can eat anything — including Mateo's map. What can these animals do, and what can't they do? Put on your boots and find out on the farm!

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the farm animals.

words.clue: White and woolly. It says baa!
It climbs everywhere and eats everything!
You can ride it. It runs fast.
Like a small grey horse with long ears.
She gives us eggs every morning.
It swims on the pond and says quack.

activities.title: Match the animal with what it gives or does.
Listen to the farm visit. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Sofía (guía) y Mateo (víctima del burro).
data.script: Sofia: Welcome to Grandpa Pablo's farm! First, the field with twelve cows. … Mateo: They are so big! And so calm. … Sofia: Now the hens. Grandpa collects thirty eggs every morning! … Mateo: Hey! The donkey is eating my sandwich! … Sofia: That's Paco. He loves cheese sandwiches. … Mateo: Now he's my best friend. Can I ride the horse? … Sofia: Yes, the brown one. Hold on well! … Mateo: Best. Trip. Ever!
